title.en: Equilibrium of a particle and friction

hook.en: Push a heavy almirah gently and it does not move. Push harder and it suddenly slides. Friction adjusts itself, but only up to a limit.
hook.kn: ಭಾರವಾದ ಅಲ್ಮೇರಾವನ್ನು ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ತಳ್ಳಿದರೆ ಅದು ಚಲಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಜೋರಾಗಿ ತಳ್ಳಿದರೆ ಥಟ್ಟನೆ ಜಾರುತ್ತದೆ. ಘರ್ಷಣೆ ತನ್ನನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೆ ಒಂದು ಮಿತಿಯವರೆಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ.

narration.en: Push a heavy almirah gently and it does not move. Push harder and it suddenly slides. Friction adjusts itself, but only up to a limit.
narration.kn: ಭಾರವಾದ ಅಲ್ಮೇರಾವನ್ನು ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ತಳ್ಳಿದರೆ ಅದು ಚಲಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಜೋರಾಗಿ ತಳ್ಳಿದರೆ ಥಟ್ಟನೆ ಜಾರುತ್ತದೆ. ಘರ್ಷಣೆ ತನ್ನನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೆ ಒಂದು ಮಿತಿಯವರೆಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ.

body.en: A particle is in equilibrium when the net external force on it is zero. For three concurrent forces this means $\vec F_1 + \vec F_2 + \vec F_3 = 0$: drawn head to tail they form a closed triangle. In component form, $\sum F_x = 0$ and $\sum F_y = 0$.
body.kn: ಕಣದ ಮೇಲಿನ ನಿವ್ವಳ ಬಾಹ್ಯ ಬಲ ಶೂನ್ಯವಾದಾಗ ಅದು ಸಮತೋಲನದಲ್ಲಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಮೂರು ಬಲಗಳು ಸಮತೋಲನದಲ್ಲಿದ್ದರೆ ಅವು ತಲೆ-ಬಾಲ ಕ್ರಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಚ್ಚಿದ ತ್ರಿಭುಜವನ್ನು ರಚಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

points.en: Any one force balances the resultant of the other two

say.en: Three forces on a particle balance when, drawn head to tail, they close a triangle.
In components, the x-forces add to zero and the y-forces add to zero.
Pull a block on a rough floor. Friction acts along the surface against the motion, or against the motion that is about to start.
As the pull grows, static friction grows with it up to the limit mu s N. Then the block slips and kinetic friction, a little smaller, takes over.

narration.en: On the board: Balanced forces and friction.

body.en: Static friction opposes impending motion and can take any value up to a maximum: $f_s \le \mu_s N$. Once the body slides, kinetic friction $f_k = \mu_k N$ acts, and $\mu_k < \mu_s$. Friction depends on the normal reaction, not on the area of contact. Rolling friction is much smaller still.
body.kn: ಸ್ಥಿರ ಘರ್ಷಣೆ ಚಲನೆಯ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭವನ್ನು ವಿರೋಧಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು μ_s N ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಮಿತಿಯವರೆಗೆ ಯಾವ ಬೆಲೆಯನ್ನಾದರೂ ಪಡೆಯಬಹುದು. ಕಾಯ ಜಾರತೊಡಗಿದ ನಂತರ ಚಲನ ಘರ್ಷಣೆ μ_k N ವರ್ತಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; μ_k < μ_s. ಘರ್ಷಣೆ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಫಲವನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

points.en: On an incline a block is about to slide when tan θ = μ_s
Friction does not depend on the area of contact

aim.en: Increase the pull on a block step by step, record the limiting friction for different normal reactions, and find μ from the slope of the graph.

caption.en: A block on an incline: it slides when the pull down the slope (g sin θ) beats the greatest friction (μ g cos θ). The curves cross at the angle of repose.

tryThis.en: Raise θ until the net read-out turns positive. Compare θ with tan⁻¹ μ.
Halve μ. Does the block start sliding at a smaller angle?
At θ = 0, why is the friction read-out not the actual friction force?

problem.en: A 10 kg block rests on a floor with μ_s = 0.4 and μ_k = 0.3 (g = 10 m/s²). What horizontal force just starts it moving, and what force keeps it moving at constant speed?

steps.en: Limiting friction = μ_s N = 40 N, so a push just over 40 N starts it.
Kinetic friction = μ_k N = 30 N, so 30 N keeps it moving at constant speed.

answer.en: 40 N to start; 30 N to keep it moving

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A 10 kg block rests on a floor with μ_s = 0.4 and μ_k = 0.3 (g = 10 m/s²). What horizontal force just starts it moving, and what force keeps it moving at constant speed?

problem.en: A block placed on a plank just begins to slide when the plank is tilted to 30°. Find μ_s.

steps.en: At the point of sliding, mg sin θ = μ_s mg cos θ.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A block placed on a plank just begins to slide when the plank is tilted to 30°. Find μ_s.

body.en: A block on an incline is about to slide when tan θ = μ_s. So the angle of repose gives the coefficient of static friction directly.

narration.en: Angle of repose. A block on an incline is about to slide when tan θ = μ_s. So the angle of repose gives the coefficient of static friction directly.

mnemonic.en: Tan of the slipping angle equals mu.

points.en: Equilibrium: net force zero, ΣFₓ = ΣFᵧ = 0.
points.kn: ಸಮತೋಲನ: ನಿವ್ವಳ ಬಲ ಶೂನ್ಯ, ΣFₓ = ΣFᵧ = 0.

points.en: Static friction adjusts itself up to μ_s N.
points.kn: ಸ್ಥಿರ ಘರ್ಷಣೆ μ_s N ವರೆಗೆ ಸ್ವಯಂ ಹೊಂದಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Kinetic friction μ_k N is less than limiting friction.
points.kn: ಚಲನ ಘರ್ಷಣೆ μ_k N ಮಿತಿ ಘರ್ಷಣೆಗಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ.

homework.en: A 4 kg block is pulled by 30 N on a floor with μ_k = 0.5. Find its acceleration (g = 10 m/s²; answer: 2.5 m/s²).

narration.en: Recap. Equilibrium: net force zero, ΣFₓ = ΣFᵧ = 0. Static friction adjusts itself up to μ_s N. Kinetic friction μ_k N is less than limiting friction.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಸಮತೋಲನ: ನಿವ್ವಳ ಬಲ ಶೂನ್ಯ, ΣFₓ = ΣFᵧ = 0. ಸ್ಥಿರ ಘರ್ಷಣೆ μ_s N ವರೆಗೆ ಸ್ವಯಂ ಹೊಂದಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ. ಚಲನ ಘರ್ಷಣೆ μ_k N ಮಿತಿ ಘರ್ಷಣೆಗಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ.
